models: Native local source export per game, not source-swapped catalog assets
shared_stats: HoennVR generated gamedata, modern/SV baseline; not per-game damage parity
za_parameters: Decoded za-v2 rows; selected native body cue/hold/rate interpreter now adapted in BattleLab.Native.
arceus_scheduler: Experimental delay model informed by official action-order description; not reverse-engineered formula
bdsp_scheduler: Conventional round / priority / Speed subset; not complete BDSP engine
effects: Eight native ZA particle/timeline exports and eight original BDSP sequences from local dumps. Arceus bodies use ZA effects/timing, not native Arceus effects. Sound remains synthetic.

initial_lab.za_parameters: HoennVR Data/za_moves.json, decoded za-v2 rows. Native timeline interpreter is NOT included.
initial_lab.effects: Diagnostic Unity geometry and synthesized sound, not native move effects

direct_control: Experimental camera-relative Pokemon movement, dash window, range-at-marker collision, Quick Attack burst; not native locomotion or root motion.
